WHAT_A_SCORE_IS: a reading assignment, ranked by what would be at stake if the provenance turned out to be model-derived. IT IS NOT A DEFECT AND NOT A FINDING. No threshold separates pass from fail, on purpose. Verdicts are written by hand in verdicts.yaml after reading the source, and each names its evidence.
WHY_unread_source_IS_WEIGHTED_LOW: almost every reference is unread by this standard (19 of 1,068), so on its own the signal separates nothing. It is kept because it compounds with the others.
